proposal_id_sequence.source_comment: Ids count up from 0; proposalCount is the next one.

source_and_abi_observations.proposal_flow_comment: An owner proposes a call (target, value, data); proposing counts as their confirmation. Once threshold owners have confirmed, any owner can execute it, once. Confirmations are counted at execution against the current owners and threshold.
source_and_abi_observations.owner_threshold_control_comment: The owners and threshold change only through the multisig's own proposals (target = this contract), so the same M-of-N guards the owner set.
abi_events: Proposed(uint256 indexed id,address indexed proposer,address indexed target,uint256 value,bytes data)
source_and_abi_observations.important_capability: Because proposals(id) and proposalCount() are public view getters, prior proposal targets and calldata can be inspected with read-only eth_call without relying on internal transaction traces.

multisig_log.interpretation: Matches ABI event Executed(uint256 indexed id,address indexed executor).
